0.name: TEXT_CTSHWDTERRITORY_00639_AUGEBERT_000_000
0.description: Well, if it ain't <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. You couldn't have come at a better time, my friend.
0.translation_description: Ah, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>! Non potevi arrivare in un momento migliore, <hex:020819E905FF0A616D696361206D6961FF0A616D69636F206D696F03>.

1.name: TEXT_CTSHWDTERRITORY_00639_AUGEBERT_000_010
1.description: As you can see, we're havin' ourselves a bit of fun at the moment. To celebrate the completion of works, the residents and artisans decided to get together and host a festival.
1.translation_description: Come vedi, oggi ci stiamo divertendo un po'. Per festeggiare la conclusione dei lavori, i residenti e gli artigiani hanno deciso di ritrovarsi e organizzare una festa.

2.name: TEXT_CTSHWDTERRITORY_00639_AUGEBERT_000_020
2.description: The Skyrise Celebration, it's called, and it's got somethin' for everyone. If you're not otherwise occupied, I reckon you'd enjoy takin' part in some fêtes. They're held regularly and offer some fine rewards.
2.translation_description: La chiamiamo Celebrazione del Firmamento e offre qualcosa per tutti. Se non hai altri impegni, secondo me ti divertirai a partecipare a qualche fête. Si tengono regolarmente e offrono premi davvero interessanti.

3.name: TEXT_CTSHWDTERRITORY_00639_SYSTEM_000_030
3.description: During the Skyrise Celebration, various diverting games known as fêtes are held at regular intervals and in succession. Information on when the next fêtes will take place can be viewed while in the Firmament.
3.translation_description: Durante la Celebrazione del Firmamento si svolgono a intervalli regolari varie attività divertenti chiamate fêtes, una dopo l’altra. Puoi consultare le informazioni sulle prossime fêtes mentre ti trovi al Firmamento.

4.name: TEXT_CTSHWDTERRITORY_00639_SYSTEM_000_040
4.description: In order to participate and earn rewards, you must be a Disciple of the Hand or the Land.
4.translation_description: Per partecipare e ricevere le ricompense, devi essere un Discepolo della Mano o della Terra.
